claim: NVIDIA launched an open agent-safety platform combining runtime enforcement with out-of-band monitoring from testing through deployment.
verifiedFacts: NVIDIA announced Open Agent Safety Platform on September 28, 2026.
OpenShell provides a runtime boundary, traces actions and enforces policy.
inference: Agent governance is separating into model safeguards, harness permissions, runtime enforcement and independent monitoring.
This strengthens the case for a layered, vendor-neutral agent-boundary audit rather than a single safety control.
significance: High: runtime containment is becoming a distinct engineering surface.
knownLimitations: Provider announcements do not establish independent reliability or buyer criteria.
